text:
Marta (Design): quick copy + a11y check on this confirm modal — screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/arch-modal.png
Marta (Design): Primary is red 'Archive', secondary is 'Cancel'. feels a bit vague and i'm worried keyboard focus lands on the wrong affordance. thoughts?
Sam (Product): Agree 'Cancel' is ambiguous here. Users might not know what they're canceling. Suggest 'Keep version' as the secondary label so intent is explicit.
Jordan (Eng): implementation note: swapping button order is trivial (html order) but we should keep to platform convention: destructive action on the right. That means secondary HTML-first, primary last. keyboard focus will follow DOM order unless we override tabindex.
Ava (Accessibility): +1 to explicit labels. Also add an aria-describedby pointing to the explanatory copy so screen readers get context. Example: `aria-describedby="archive-desc"`. For the button aria-labels, include the version id if available (e.g., `aria-label="Keep version 1.3"`).
Marta (Design): Proposed copy: Header: "Archive this version?" Body: "Archived versions are removed from the active list. You can restore them within 30 days." Primary: "Archive version" Secondary: "Keep version". Also change order so [Keep version] [Archive version].
Kevin (Design Eng): one small nit: analytics show shorter CTAs perform better on small widths. maybe `Archive` / `Keep` visually, but add the longer accessible label via `aria-label` for SR users. Also ensure we have a tooltip for truncated buttons on mobile.
Rachel (PM): :thumbsup: I prefer explicit labels for clarity across audiences. flag for i18n — german and ja might expand a lot, can we ask locale team for char counts?
Jordan (Eng): i'll update the modal component and add `aria-describedby` support. PR will include visual diff + axe results.
Ava (Accessibility): please add a keyboard-only walkthrough test in the PR description (tab order, enter to confirm, escape to cancel). also run our axe checks and mention any false positives.
Marta (Design): thanks — i'll update copy in the design file and include both short visual label + `aria-label` suggestion. final microcopy to land in PR: header/body/primary/secondary as above.
Kevin (Design Eng): i'll prototype both variants (short visible label + aria label) and attach screenshots.
Rachel (PM): great, assigning follow-ups: jordan -> component tweak, kevin -> prototype, marta -> copy update + i18n note, ava -> accessibility checklist.
Marta (Design): perfect, thanks everyone. will post the updated mock and link the PR when ready. :sparkles:
